name: CASTECH Inc.
blurb: CASTECH Inc. is a Chinese company listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange. The company is primarily engaged in the research, development, production, and sale of optical crystals and related components. It serves various industries including laser, optical communication, and scientific research. CASTECH is recognized as a leading supplier in the global optical crystal market.
